articles.hook: The promise the whole Constitution keeps: justice, liberty, equality and fraternity.

Every section of citizens may conserve its own language, script and culture.
Minorities may establish and administer their own educational institutions.
The right to move the Supreme Court to enforce your fundamental rights.
Equal justice and free legal aid, so no one is denied justice for want of means.

The State shall endeavour to secure a uniform civil code.
